original.statement: The `--cluster` flag behavior changed to show flows emitted from nodes outside of the provided cluster name (either coming from or going to the target cluster), rather than only flows within that cluster.

exposure.needed: whether operators or automation run Hubble CLI commands (e.g. hubble observe) with the --cluster flag and depend on its previous filtering results

corrected.statement: The Hubble CLI `--cluster` flag now also shows flows emitted from nodes outside the named cluster that come from or go to that cluster. Users who still need the old result can use `--node-name foo/` instead. Only users who run Hubble CLI commands or scripts with `--cluster` are exposed, and static configuration cannot show whether that happens.

decision.reason: [ev-868456a7673f] places this change under "1.17 Upgrade Notes › Hubble CLI", so `--cluster` is a flag that users pass to the Hubble CLI. It is not a container argument of any Cilium workload. The proposed cli-flag leaf checks container args, so it would never detect this usage. Users who are exposed (anyone running Hubble CLI queries or scripts with `--cluster`) cannot be seen in any static environment input, so the exposure has to be undecidable rather than a cli-flag predicate.
